America is preparing for a new chapter in nuclear warfare. A mysterious designation, B94, has surfaced in a US Senate spending document, with $77.108 million proposed for the programme in the 2027 budget. Experts believe it could be linked to a new air-delivered nuclear weapon designed to destroy deeply buried enemy facilities.
The revelation comes as America tests its nuclear-capable Minuteman III missile ahead of a major Trump engagement with Putin and Xi.
